quick.description: Atomic, familiar work with an explicit expected result and cheap verification; no material ambiguity or interacting constraints.

light.description: Routine technical work with known patterns, bounded context, several explicit constraints, and contained failure impact.

balanced.description: Substantive but bounded work that can be understood and completed without sustained hypothesis management or compounding decisions.

strong.description: Difficult or high-stakes work requiring sustained judgment, but with a reasonably clear problem boundary and feedback loop.

deep.description: Long-horizon or highly uncertain work involving compounding decisions, difficult causal reasoning, multiple interacting unknowns, or early assumptions that materially affect later work.
